text:
alex: Quick announce: KV-cache prefill + traffic-shaping experiment tomorrow 2026-06-04 02:00 UTC for 45m. Goal: confirm warm-hit % gains and p99 impact before quantized rollout. We'll relax internal p99 SLO for /v1/generate from 120ms -> 220ms for affected canary pools.

mina: which regions/tenants?

alex: Canary only: ~10% traffic in region-usw1 and region-eu1. Opt-in customers + internal tests. No dedicated reserved capacity changed.

jamal: oncall ack. I'll monitor and rollback if alerts fire.

olivia: internal-only, right? legal/compliance ok?

alex: Internal only. Compliance and PMs for opt-ins are notified. We'll abort on any customer-visible anomalies.

rohit: please share runbook and watch queries.

alex: Short runbook: 1) Watch dash https://dash.board/redwood/kvcache-prefill 2) If p99 > 300ms and error_rate > 0.5% for 3m -> `rdctl routing set /v1/generate default` 3) If GPU mem > 85% -> `feature-flag set kvcache_prefill=false`

alex: PromQL we'll use: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(latency_ms_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le))` and `100 * rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",status!~"2.."}[3m])`

sre-bot: Reminder scheduled (starts in ~10m). :bell:

mina: infra, expect transient read/disk/network pressure on canaries.

alex: infra aware; throttles in place.

jamal: quiet window for noisy jobs set.

rohit: adding synthetic stabilizer: `./stressgen --route /v1/generate --qps 50 --seq 1024 --duration 1800s`

deploy-bot: deploy started: kvcache-prefill-v2 -> canary-pool (d-99234). CI: https://ci/redwood/d-99234

jamal: monitoring health checks and rollback steps ready.

alex: TL;DR: 45m experiment, internal p99 relaxation for canary /v1/generate, runbook + dashboards posted, oncall + infra watching. Ping @jamal or me if you see anything. :rocket:
